sidebar.title: Player Facing Rules
sidebar.p: In a Player-Facing rules system the Players make all the dice rolls, when a goblin attack a PC the Player rolls for defence, the goblin does not roll to hit. Malleus Deum has adopted a Player-Facing design since, it has been argued that, this approach has the following benefits:

descriptions.description: Player Facing rolls push work from the busy GM to the players, reducing GM workload allows them to concentrate on other aspects of the game.
Because the players roll they feel that fate is in their hands.
When the players roll it feels less like they are competing against the GM.
